entries.zh_CN: 小芽：这些格子是障碍
entries.en: Ren: These Cells Are Obstacles
entries.note: 机器人英文名定为 Ren，替换 Sprout。

entries.zh_CN: 有障碍的格子不能翻开、标记或探测
entries.en: Obstacle cells cannot be revealed, marked, or scanned

entries.zh_CN: 里面也没有污染核心
entries.en: They don't contain Pollution Cores either

entries.zh_CN: 小芽：其他规则没有变化哦
entries.en: Ren: Everything Else Still Works the Same
entries.note: 机器人英文名定为 Ren，替换 Sprout。

entries.zh_CN: 障碍不用清除，净化其它格子就可以了
entries.en: Leave obstacles alone and purify the other cells

entries.zh_CN: 小芽：咦，这里长出了污染根瘤！
entries.en: Ren: Oh! A Pollution Nodule!
entries.note: 机器人英文名定为 Ren，替换 Sprout。

entries.zh_CN: 根瘤不能直接点击，但也是污染核心
entries.en: You can't click a nodule directly, but it's a Pollution Core too

entries.zh_CN: 小芽：我们从它周围下手吧！
entries.en: Ren: Let's Start Around It!
entries.note: 机器人英文名定为 Ren，替换 Sprout。

entries.zh_CN: 翻开根瘤周围全部安全格，并标记全部污染核心
entries.en: Reveal every safe cell around the nodule and mark every Pollution Core

entries.zh_CN: 周围都处理对了，根瘤就会被我们净化啦！
entries.en: Get every neighbor right and we'll cleanse the nodule!

entries.zh_CN: 小芽：古树也被污染缠住了！
entries.en: Ren: Pollution's got the old tree too!
entries.note: 机器人英文名定为 Ren，替换 Sprout。

entries.zh_CN: 古树还不能直接净化，先帮它清理三条树根吧。
entries.en: We can't cleanse the tree yet. Let's start with its three roots.

entries.zh_CN: 看！箭头指着一组根瘤，我们从这里开始吧。
entries.en: Look! The arrow points to a nodule group. Let's start there.

entries.zh_CN: 小芽：一起把整条树根清理干净吧！
entries.en: Ren: Let's cleanse the whole root together!
entries.note: 机器人英文名定为 Ren，替换 Sprout。

entries.zh_CN: 像清理单独的污染根瘤一样。
entries.en: Like cleansing a single Pollution Nodule.

entries.zh_CN: 三条树根都清干净，古树就能跟着恢复啦！
entries.en: Once all three roots are clean, the tree can recover too!

entries.zh_CN: 小芽：探测充能满啦！
entries.en: Ren: Eco probe is fully charged!
entries.note: 机器人英文名定为 Ren，替换 Sprout。

entries.zh_CN: 翻格子、做标记都能攒能量
entries.en: Revealing cells and marking both charge it

entries.zh_CN: 小芽：点击我选一个格子探测
entries.en: Ren: Click me to pick a cell to probe
entries.note: 机器人英文名定为 Ren，替换 Sprout。

entries.zh_CN: 选中的格子会直接处理好
entries.en: The chosen cell is resolved instantly

entries.zh_CN: 用不完的能量能带到下一关
entries.en: Unused energy carries over to the next level

entries.zh_CN: 小芽：我们来到海底啦！
entries.en: Ren: We've reached the seafloor!
entries.note: 机器人英文名定为 Ren，替换 Sprout。

entries.zh_CN: 这里都是六边形，每个格子有六个邻居。
entries.en: The cells here are hexagons, and each has six neighbors.

entries.zh_CN: 确定安全就翻开，认出污染核心就标记吧。
entries.en: Reveal what you know is safe, and flag the Pollution Cores you find.

entries.zh_CN: 小芽：数字还是我们的好帮手！
entries.en: Ren: The numbers still help us!
entries.note: 机器人英文名定为 Ren，替换 Sprout。

entries.zh_CN: 翻开、标记和展开，还是你熟悉的操作。
entries.en: Revealing, flagging and expanding are still the familiar controls.

entries.zh_CN: 小芽：看！这里有道珊瑚礁带！
entries.en: Ren: Look! A coral reef!
entries.note: 机器人英文名定为 Ren，替换 Sprout。

entries.zh_CN: 两格之间隔着珊瑚礁带，就不算邻居啦。
entries.en: When a coral reef blocks the edge between two cells, they aren't neighbors anymore.

entries.zh_CN: 只要贴着边、没被礁带隔开，就还是邻居哦。
entries.en: An unblocked shared edge still makes two cells neighbors.

entries.zh_CN: 小芽：我们从礁带两头绕过去吧！
entries.en: Ren: Let's go around the reef ends!
entries.note: 机器人英文名定为 Ren，替换 Sprout。

entries.zh_CN: 礁带两头能绕过去，两侧的格子也照常能翻。
entries.en: You can go around either end of the reef, and still reveal cells on both sides.

entries.zh_CN: 我们从珊瑚礁带两头绕过去吧！
entries.en: Let's go around the ends of the coral reef!

entries.zh_CN: 小芽：这些浮标会一直向右漂！
entries.en: Ren: These buoys keep drifting right!
entries.note: 机器人英文名定为 Ren，替换 Sprout。

entries.zh_CN: 每组四个浮标，只有两个藏着污染核心。
entries.en: Each group has four buoys, but only two hide Pollution Cores.

entries.zh_CN: 小芽：一起把这组浮标拦下来吧！
entries.en: Ren: Let's stop this group together!
entries.note: 机器人英文名定为 Ren，替换 Sprout。

entries.zh_CN: 翻完安全浮标、标齐污染核心，这组就会停下。
entries.en: Reveal both safe buoys and flag both Pollution Cores to stop this group.

entries.zh_CN: 没标出的污染核心漂过右侧过滤边界，就会失败。
entries.en: An unflagged Core crossing the right filter boundary ends the run.

entries.zh_CN: 小芽：一起把浮标拦下来吧！
entries.en: Ren: Let's stop the buoys together!
entries.note: 机器人英文名定为 Ren，替换 Sprout。

entries.zh_CN: 浮标全部被翻开或标记，就会停止漂移。
entries.en: The buoys stop drifting once they're all revealed or flagged.

entries.zh_CN: 没有全部解决的浮标飘过右侧的隔离边界，游戏就失败了。
entries.en: If unsolved buoys drift past the right containment boundary, you lose.

entries.zh_CN: 小芽：潮水还没退，我们一片片来吧！
entries.en: Ren: Let's clear one patch at a time!
entries.note: 机器人英文名定为 Ren，替换 Sprout。

entries.zh_CN: 把眼前这片海底的污染解决，下一片海水才会退潮。
entries.en: Clear the pollution here before the tide recedes from the next zone.

entries.zh_CN: 没退潮的地方暂时还不能翻开、标记或探测哦。
entries.en: Zones still under water can't be revealed, flagged or scanned.

entries.zh_CN: 小芽：等下一片退潮，再看看数字吧！
entries.en: Ren: Check the numbers after the tide!
entries.note: 机器人英文名定为 Ren，替换 Sprout。

entries.zh_CN: 潮水没退时，交界两边的格子还不算邻居。
entries.en: While the next zone is underwater, cells across its border aren't neighbors.

entries.zh_CN: 退潮后，交界处的数字会更新，污染核心的位置不变哦。
entries.en: When the tide recedes, border numbers update, but the Pollution Cores stay in place.

entries.zh_CN: 小芽：我们来到了天空！
entries.en: Ren: We've Reached the Sky!
entries.note: 第15关第1页中文按用户定稿，保留云球称呼；英文同步。；机器人英文名定为 Ren，替换 Sprout。

entries.zh_CN: 天空的污染核心藏在云球中哦，背面也等着你探索。
entries.en: The sky's Pollution Cores hide in the Cloud Sphere. There's more to explore on the far side, too.
entries.note: 第15关第1页中文按用户定稿，保留云球称呼；英文同步。

entries.zh_CN: 只有共用一条边的格子，才算邻居哦。
entries.en: Only cells sharing an edge count as neighbors.
entries.note: 第15关第1页中文按用户定稿，保留云球称呼；英文同步。

entries.zh_CN: 小芽：转过去看看吧！
entries.en: Ren: Let's Take a Look Around!
entries.note: 机器人英文名定为 Ren，替换 Sprout。

entries.zh_CN: 按住左键拖动，就能转动云球。
entries.en: Hold the left mouse button and drag to rotate the Cloud Sphere.
entries.note: 第15关第2页鼠标操作正文；键盘模式使用TXT_0957。

entries.zh_CN: 翻开、标记和展开，还是你熟悉的操作。
entries.en: Revealing, flagging, and expanding work just as before.

entries.zh_CN: 小芽：看，一阵微风！
entries.en: Ren: Look, a Breeze!
entries.note: 第17关两页微风引导按用户定稿：第1页介绍帮助与转向，第2页说明翻开或标记的结果。；机器人英文名定为 Ren，替换 Sprout。

entries.zh_CN: 微风是来帮助你的。
entries.en: The Breeze is here to help you.
entries.note: 第17关两页微风引导按用户定稿：第1页介绍帮助与转向，第2页说明翻开或标记的结果。

entries.zh_CN: 微风吹过时，云球会转向它找到的那一格。
entries.en: When a Breeze blows by, the Cloud Sphere turns toward the cell it found.
entries.note: 第17关两页微风引导按用户定稿：第1页介绍帮助与转向，第2页说明翻开或标记的结果。

entries.zh_CN: 小芽：看看微风发现了什么！
entries.en: Ren: See What the Breeze Found!
entries.note: 机器人英文名定为 Ren，替换 Sprout。

entries.zh_CN: 它翻开了一个安全格，或者也可能标记一个污染核心。
entries.en: It revealed a safe cell, or it may have flagged a Pollution Core.
entries.note: 第17关两页微风引导按用户定稿：第1页介绍帮助与转向，第2页说明翻开或标记的结果。

entries.zh_CN: 微风不一定每次都来，我们还是慢慢看数字吧。
entries.en: The Breeze won't help every time. Let's keep following the numbers.

entries.zh_CN: 小芽：球越来越大了！
entries.en: Ren: The sphere keeps growing!
entries.note: 第19关两页云盾引导按用户定稿：第1页介绍球变大与概率保护，第2页说明自动标记及每局最多一次。；机器人英文名定为 Ren，替换 Sprout。

entries.zh_CN: 让云盾来保护你吧。
entries.en: Let the Cloud Shield protect you.
entries.note: 第19关两页云盾引导按用户定稿：第1页介绍球变大与概率保护，第2页说明自动标记及每局最多一次。

entries.zh_CN: 误碰污染核心时，云盾也许会出现。
entries.en: If you hit a Pollution Core, the Cloud Shield may appear.
entries.note: 第19关两页云盾引导按用户定稿：第1页介绍球变大与概率保护，第2页说明自动标记及每局最多一次。

entries.zh_CN: 小芽：云盾还会帮忙标记！
entries.en: Ren: The Cloud Shield Flags It Too!
entries.note: 第19关两页云盾引导按用户定稿：第1页介绍球变大与概率保护，第2页说明自动标记及每局最多一次。；机器人英文名定为 Ren，替换 Sprout。

entries.zh_CN: 误碰的污染核心，会被云盾自动标记。
entries.en: A Pollution Core you hit gets flagged by the Cloud Shield automatically.
entries.note: 第19关两页云盾引导按用户定稿：第1页介绍球变大与概率保护，第2页说明自动标记及每局最多一次。

entries.zh_CN: 每局最多出现一次，还是要小心哦。
entries.en: It appears at most once per game, so stay careful.
entries.note: 第19关两页云盾引导按用户定稿：第1页介绍球变大与概率保护，第2页说明自动标记及每局最多一次。

entries.zh_CN: 小芽：是什么在旋转？是雷眼！
entries.en: Ren: What's spinning? A Storm Eye!
entries.note: 第20关两页雷眼引导按用户定稿：第1页认识雷眼与背面箭头，第2页说明净化条件与提前通关。；机器人英文名定为 Ren，替换 Sprout。

entries.zh_CN: 雷眼是特殊的污染核心，建议优先解决哦。
entries.en: A Storm Eye is a special Pollution Core. Try to resolve it first.
entries.note: 第20关两页雷眼引导按用户定稿：第1页认识雷眼与背面箭头，第2页说明净化条件与提前通关。

entries.zh_CN: 如果出现在云球背面，可以跟着箭头寻找。
entries.en: If one appears on the far side of the Cloud Sphere, follow the arrow to find it.
entries.note: 第20关两页雷眼引导按用户定稿：第1页认识雷眼与背面箭头，第2页说明净化条件与提前通关。

entries.zh_CN: 小芽：一起净化雷眼吧！
entries.en: Ren: Let's Cleanse the Storm Eye!
entries.note: 机器人英文名定为 Ren，替换 Sprout。

entries.zh_CN: 全部雷格都被正确翻开或标记的话，雷眼就被净化了。
entries.en: Once every surrounding cell is correctly revealed or flagged, the Storm Eye is cleansed.
entries.note: 第20关两页雷眼引导按用户定稿：第1页认识雷眼与背面箭头，第2页说明净化条件与提前通关。

entries.zh_CN: 这一关的雷眼全部净化，就能提前通关啦！
entries.en: Cleanse every Storm Eye in this level to finish early!
entries.note: 第20关两页雷眼引导按用户定稿：第1页认识雷眼与背面箭头，第2页说明净化条件与提前通关。

entries.zh_CN: 小芽：宇宙棋盘要看连线
entries.en: Ren: Follow the Links in the Universe
entries.note: 机器人英文名定为 Ren，替换 Sprout。

entries.zh_CN: 两颗星核之间有线才算相邻，距离远近并不重要。
entries.en: Two star cores are adjacent only when a line connects them; distance does not matter.

entries.zh_CN: 没有连线的星核互不影响。
entries.en: Star cores without a connecting line do not affect each other.

entries.zh_CN: 小芽：直线和弧线都有效
entries.en: Ren: Straight and Curved Links Both Count
entries.note: 机器人英文名定为 Ren，替换 Sprout。

entries.zh_CN: 银灰色直线和青蓝色弧线都表示正常相邻。
entries.en: Silver straight lines and cyan arcs both indicate normal adjacency.

entries.zh_CN: 数字是所有直接相连星核中的污染总数。
entries.en: A number counts pollution among every directly connected star core.

entries.zh_CN: 小芽：星舰有两层护盾
entries.en: Ren: The Starship Has Two Shield Layers
entries.note: 机器人英文名定为 Ren，替换 Sprout。

entries.zh_CN: 误触污染会消耗一层护盾，并自动标记那颗星核。
entries.en: Hitting pollution consumes one shield layer and flags that star core automatically.

entries.zh_CN: 两层护盾都用完后，再误触才会结束远征。
entries.en: After both layers are gone, the next polluted core ends the expedition.

entries.zh_CN: 小芽：紫色连线是虫洞
entries.en: Ren: Purple Links Are Wormholes
entries.note: 机器人英文名定为 Ren，替换 Sprout。

entries.zh_CN: 虫洞两端的星核即使离得很远，也算直接相邻。
entries.en: Star cores at the two ends of a wormhole are directly adjacent, however far apart they appear.

entries.zh_CN: 数字会把虫洞另一端的污染计算进去。
entries.en: Numbers include pollution at the far end of a wormhole.

entries.zh_CN: 小芽：把它当成普通连线
entries.en: Ren: Treat It Like Any Other Link
entries.note: 机器人英文名定为 Ren，替换 Sprout。

entries.zh_CN: 判断数字时，沿紫色线找到另一端一起计算。
entries.en: When reading a number, follow the purple line and include its other endpoint.

entries.zh_CN: 除了距离很远，规则和其他连线完全相同。
entries.en: Apart from the long distance, it follows exactly the same rules as any other link.

entries.zh_CN:
【目标、数字与计数】
基础完成条件是翻开全部安全格；漂流物、污染根瘤和雷眼等特殊机制还要求正确处理关联格。数字表示按当前章节邻接规则与该格直接相邻的污染数量，陆地污染根瘤也会计入数字。顶部X/Y表示已用标记/本关核心总数；错误标记和自动标记都会计入X，陆地不可标记根瘤不计入Y。满足数字且周围标记全部正确时，陆地、海洋和天空可双击已翻开的数字（键盘模式按J）展开其余邻格；宇宙再次左键单击已翻开的数字即可展开。

【鼠标操作】
陆地/海洋：左键翻开，右键标记，双击已翻开的数字展开。天空：左键翻开，右键标记，拖拽旋转球体，双击已翻开的数字展开。宇宙：左键翻开，右键标记，再次左键单击已翻开的数字展开。陆地、海洋和天空的生态探测充满后，按C或点击机器人，再选择一个隐藏格；右键、Esc或C可取消选格，陆地/海洋键盘模式也可按K。宇宙当前没有生态探测。非探测状态下Esc打开或关闭暂停菜单。

【键盘与菜单】
在设置中选择键盘模式后，陆地/海洋使用方向键或W S A D移动光标，J翻开或展开数字，K标记；天空使用方向键选择相邻球面格、W S A D旋转球体、J翻开或展开数字、K标记、R将当前格转到正面。C在前三章使用生态探测。键盘模式下鼠标仍可用。宇宙棋盘当前仅支持鼠标，操作方式设置不会改变宇宙操作。菜单可用方向键选择、Enter/空格确认。F11或Alt+Enter切换显示模式。

【生态探测】
陆地、海洋和天空中，每次有效翻开或展开操作，以及每个格子的首次标记，都会积累1点能量；一次操作即使展开多格也只增加1点，能量可带到下一关。每关先完成首次翻格后才能使用探测。机器人头顶三个光点表示12点充能的4/8/12三个阶段。选择隐藏格后，安全格会自动翻开，污染核心会确认并自动标记；探测随即清空能量并重新充能。宇宙不使用生态探测。

【第1～7关：陆地，方格最多8邻接】
第1关：5×5、5个核心；第2关：6×6、8个核心；第3关：8×8、9个核心，遗迹障碍不可操作且不参与邻接；第4关：9×9、12个核心，随机障碍群改变可操作区域。
第5～7关的污染根瘤不可操作并计入邻近数字；翻开邻近安全格并正确标记邻近核心后自动净化。首次处理任一未净化根瘤时，启动本关唯一共享倒计时；普通操作不续时，净化一组会刷新完整时长。超时后，所有未净化且已有进度的根瘤向外扩张一环并重新污染该范围：安全格重新闭合，范围内标记与探测确认撤销，同样数量的核心在范围内重排；范围外开合、标记和核心位置不变，边缘数字会随重算更新。暂停、引导和交互锁定期间停表。
第5关：10×10、13个核心、1组随机障碍、2个根瘤，共享45秒；第6关：12×12、17个核心、2组随机障碍、3个根瘤，共享40秒；第7关：13×13、20个核心、三条根系（每条3个根瘤）与污染母株，共享60秒，依次净化三条根系后净化Boss。

【第8～14关：海洋，六边形最多6邻接】
只有共享边的六边形才相邻，第10关开始出现的珊瑚墙会切断数字、零格展开和数字连锁。第8关：6×6、7个核心；第9关：8×7、10个核心；第10关：9×8、14个核心、2段墙。
第11关：10×9、17个总核心；两组漂流物每7秒轮流右移，每组含2个安全浮标和2颗水雷。第12关：11×10、21个总核心；三组漂流物每6秒轮流右移。安全浮标需翻开，水雷需标记；解决一组只停止该组，未完成组的任一浮标越过右侧隔离边界即失败，移动后所有相关数字实时重算。
第13关：12×11、25个核心、1段墙和2个潮区；第14关：13×12、30个核心、2段墙和3个潮区。只能操作当前亮起潮区，完成后解锁下一潮区并自动展开安全片区；已退潮区域仍可操作，边界数字会重新计算。

【第15～21关：天空，球面共享边邻接】
五边形有5个邻格，六边形有6个邻格；只有球面共享边才相邻，背面仍属于同一棋盘，每局首次翻开必定安全。第15关32面/6核心；第16关42面/8；第17关92面/15；第18关162面/26；第19关252面/40；第20关362面/58；第21关492面/78。
第17～21关每次安全翻格有20%概率触发吹风，随机翻开安全格或自动标记核心。第19～21关另有一面云盾，误触核心时70%概率成功保护并自动标记，成功后本局消耗。第20/21关依探索进度出现3/5道雷眼，雷眼已包含在58/78总核心内；雷眼本体不可操作，处理周围安全格和普通核心后会自动击破，无需双击，击破全部雷眼即获胜。

【宇宙远征】
宇宙没有编号关卡、独立地图、生态探测或勋章本，棋盘目前仅支持鼠标。左侧显示本次远征数据，右侧可暂停、开启新宇宙或返回天空篇。只有发光连线才相邻；银灰直线、青蓝弧线和紫色虫洞都计入数字。
每张棋盘首次净化必定安全：前两张另保护2颗邻星，第3～4张另保护1颗，之后只保护首点。星舰初始有2层护盾；误触污染先消耗1层并自动标记，护盾耗尽后再误触才失败。完成第7张棋盘恢复1层，此后每5张再恢复1层，上限2层。翻开当前棋盘全部安全星核后自动生成下一张。
每次真正生成新棋盘——首次进入、成功推进或重新远征——终身累计立即加1；失败、暂停、退出和界面刷新不会清零或重复计数。首次生成第1000张时冻结当前远征，播放一次性透视滚动字幕并揭示奖杯，随后自动进入勋章殿堂完成放置；关闭殿堂后恢复同一张第1000棋盘。

【勋章、勋章本与殿堂】
陆地、海洋或天空任一关胜利后，该关勋章会在中央旋转放大并伴随金色辉光。任意鼠标键、Space、Enter或手柄按钮可收入对应章节勋章本。从胜利进入勋章本后，左键、Space、Enter或手柄按钮继续下一关/章节；右键或Esc返回当前胜利界面；右下按钮打开勋章殿堂。
欢迎页、地图和设置页的勋章入口都进入勋章殿堂。殿堂没有返回按钮：左键或右键点击四个展示台之外的空白处，或按Esc返回进入前页面。陆地、海洋、天空封皮可打开对应勋章本；宇宙展示台没有按钮和勋章本。1000前按十进制展示累计值：小行星是个位、大行星是十位、小星团是百位；达到1000后永久显示旋转银河与终极奖杯，累计数字继续增长。

【导航、设置与辅助】
欢迎页“开始旅程”进入陆地地图，“勋章殿堂”进入殿堂。地图单击节点选择、再次单击进入；从暂停进入地图时“返回关卡”恢复原局，普通地图使用“进入所选关卡”。陆地篇没有上一章，章节导航不会循环。天空地图的下一章节进入宇宙，宇宙可返回天空篇。
设置可调整总音量、BGM、音效、显示模式、前三章鼠标/键盘操作方式和中英文，并自动保存。陆地/海洋默认首翻可能触雷；同关连续2次首翻失败后，下一局保证首翻安全；连续3次在前5步内失败后，下一局直接打开安全区域。天空和宇宙每局首翻始终安全。
陆地、海洋、天空暂停菜单可继续、重开、进入关卡选择、设置、操作说明、返回主菜单或退出；宇宙暂停菜单可继续、开启新宇宙、设置、操作说明、返回欢迎界面或退出，常驻右栏另可返回天空篇。
entries.en:
[GOALS, NUMBERS, AND COUNTER]
The basic goal is to reveal every safe cell; drift groups, pollution nodules, Storm Eyes, and other special mechanics also require their related cells to be resolved. A number counts pollution directly adjacent under the current chapter's rules, and Land pollution nodules count too. The top X/Y means flags used / total cores. Wrong and automatic flags increase X; unflaggable Land nodules are excluded from Y. When every surrounding flag is correct and the count matches, double-click a revealed number in Land, Ocean, or Sky (or press J in Keyboard mode) to expand. In Universe, click a revealed number again.

[MOUSE CONTROLS]
Land/Ocean: left-click to reveal, right-click to flag, and double-click a revealed number to expand. Sky: left-click to reveal, right-click to flag, drag to rotate, and double-click a revealed number to expand. Universe: left-click to reveal, right-click to flag, and click a revealed number again to expand. In Land, Ocean, and Sky, press C or click the robot when Eco Scan is full, then choose a hidden cell. Cancel with Right Click, Esc, or C; Keyboard mode in Land/Ocean also accepts K. Universe has no Eco Scan. Outside Scan targeting, Esc toggles pause.

[KEYBOARD AND MENUS]
In Keyboard mode, Land/Ocean use Arrows or W S A D to move, J to reveal or expand, and K to flag. Sky uses Arrows to select an adjacent face, W S A D to rotate, J to reveal or expand, K to flag, and R to center the selected face. C activates Eco Scan in the first three chapters. Mouse remains available. Universe board play is mouse-only and ignores the Controls setting. Menus use Arrows and Enter/Space. F11 or Alt+Enter changes display mode.

[ECO SCAN]
In Land, Ocean, and Sky, each successful reveal/expand action and the first flag placed on each cell add 1 energy. One action still adds only 1 even if it opens several cells, and energy carries between levels. Each level requires one reveal before Scan can be used. The robot's three lights mark 4/8/12 energy. A scanned safe cell is revealed automatically; a Pollution Core is confirmed and flagged automatically. The charge then empties and must refill. Universe has no Eco Scan.

[LEVELS 1–7: LAND, UP TO 8 SQUARE NEIGHBORS]
Level 1: 5×5/5 cores; Level 2: 6×6/8; Level 3: 8×8/9 with inoperable ruins ignored by adjacency; Level 4: 9×9/12 with random obstacle clusters.
Pollution nodules on Levels 5–7 cannot be operated and count in nearby numbers. Reveal safe neighbors and correctly flag polluted neighbors to cleanse them. The first action around any uncleansed nodule starts one shared timer for the level. Ordinary actions do not extend it; cleansing one group resets the full time. On timeout, every uncleansed group with progress repollutes its local area plus one outer ring: safe cells close, flags and Scan confirmations clear, and the same number of cores is redistributed inside. Outside reveal states, flags, and core positions stay unchanged; boundary numbers update. Pauses, guides, and interaction locks stop the timer.
Level 5: 10×10/13, 1 obstacle cluster, 2 nodules, shared 45 seconds. Level 6: 12×12/17, 2 obstacle clusters, 3 nodules, shared 40 seconds. Level 7: 13×13/20, three roots with 3 nodules each, and the mother tree, shared 60 seconds; cleanse all three roots to cleanse the boss.

[LEVELS 8–14: OCEAN, UP TO 6 HEX NEIGHBORS]
Only hexes sharing an edge are adjacent. Coral walls first appear in Level 10 and cut number counting, zero expansion, and chording. Level 8: 6×6/7; Level 9: 8×7/10; Level 10: 9×8/14 with 2 walls.
Level 11: 10×9/17 total cores; two drift groups take turns moving every 7 seconds, each with 2 safe buoys and 2 mines. Level 12: 11×10/21 total; three groups move every 6 seconds. Reveal buoys and flag mines. Solving one group stops only that group; any buoy in an unresolved group crossing the right isolation boundary causes failure, and related numbers recalculate after every move.
Level 13: 12×11/25 with 1 wall and 2 tidal zones. Level 14: 13×12/30 with 2 walls and 3 zones. Only the lit zone can be played; completion unlocks the next and opens a safe patch. Earlier zones remain playable and boundary numbers recalculate.

[LEVELS 15–21: SKY, SHARED-EDGE SPHERE ADJACENCY]
Pentagons have 5 neighbors and hexagons have 6; only shared sphere edges count, rear faces remain on the same board, and every first reveal is safe. Levels 15–21 use 32/6, 42/8, 92/15, 162/26, 252/40, 362/58, and 492/78 faces/cores.
On Levels 17–21, each safe reveal has a one-in-five chance to trigger Breeze Aid, revealing a safe face or auto-flagging a core. Levels 19–21 also have one Cloud Shield: a core hit has a seven-in-ten chance to be blocked and auto-flagged, consuming the shield on success. Levels 20/21 reveal 3/5 Storm Eyes as exploration advances; these Eyes are included in the 58/78 total. Eyes cannot be operated and break automatically when their safe and polluted neighbors are resolved—no double-click required. Break them all to win.

[UNIVERSE EXPEDITION]
Universe has no numbered levels, separate map, Eco Scan, or Badge Book, and board play is mouse-only. The left panel shows expedition data; the right panel pauses, starts a new Universe, or returns to Sky. Only glowing links are adjacent; silver lines, cyan curves, and purple wormholes all count.
Every first reveal is safe: Boards 1–2 also protect 2 neighbors, Boards 3–4 protect 1, and later boards protect only the chosen node. The ship starts with 2 shields. Hitting pollution first consumes 1 shield and auto-flags it; a hit after shields are gone ends the expedition. Board 7 restores 1 shield, then every 5 boards restores another, up to 2. Revealing every safe star automatically generates the next board.
Every genuinely generated board—initial entry, successful advance, or new expedition—adds 1 to the lifetime total. Failure, pause, exit, and UI refresh never reset or duplicate it. The first generation of Board 1,000 freezes the expedition for a one-time perspective crawl and trophy reveal, then opens Badge Hall for placement. Closing the Hall resumes that same board.

[BADGES, BADGE BOOKS, AND BADGE HALL]
After any Land, Ocean, or Sky victory, that level's badge spins and grows at center with a golden glow. Any mouse button, Space, Enter, or a gamepad button stores it in that chapter's Badge Book. From victory, Left Click, Space, Enter, or gamepad continues to the next level/chapter; Right Click or Esc returns to victory; the bottom-right button opens Badge Hall.
Badge entries on the welcome screen, maps, and Settings all open Badge Hall. The Hall has no Back button: left- or right-click outside the four showcases, or press Esc, to return. Land, Ocean, and Sky covers open their Badge Books; Universe has no button or Badge Book. Before 1,000, asteroids show ones, planets tens, and clusters hundreds. At 1,000, a permanently rotating galaxy and trophy replace those counters while the numeric lifetime total keeps growing.

[NAVIGATION, SETTINGS, AND ASSISTS]
“Start Journey” opens the Land map and “Badge Hall” opens the Hall. Click a map node once to select and again to enter. From pause, “Back to Level” resumes the current game; normal maps use “Enter Selected Level.” Land has no previous chapter and chapter navigation does not loop. Sky's next chapter enters Universe, and Universe can return to Sky.
Settings control master volume, BGM, SFX, display mode, mouse/keyboard controls for the first three chapters, and language, and save automatically. Land/Ocean may hit pollution on the first reveal by default. After 2 consecutive first-reveal losses, the next attempt guarantees safety; after 3 consecutive losses within the first 5 moves, the next attempt opens a safe region. Sky and Universe always guarantee the first reveal.
Land, Ocean, and Sky pause menus can resume, restart, open Level Select, Settings, or this guide, return to the main menu, or quit. Universe pause can resume, start a new Universe, open Settings or this guide, return to the welcome screen, or quit; its right panel separately returns to Sky.

entries.zh_CN: 数字表示周围八格中的污染数量，不指出具体位置。空白表示周围没有污染，会自动展开相连的安全区。
entries.en: A number counts pollution among the eight surrounding cells but does not show where it is. A blank means no pollution nearby and opens the connected safe area automatically.
entries.note: 操作说明窗口正文保持通顺完整；按用户澄清撤销压短。

entries.zh_CN: 右侧目标栏告诉你这一关还需要完成什么，状态栏回应刚才的操作。根瘤、根系等特殊任务的进度，也会显示在目标栏。
entries.en: The objective panel on the right shows what remains for this level, and the status panel responds to your last action. Progress on special tasks such as nodules and roots also appears in the objective panel.
entries.note: 操作说明窗口正文保持通顺完整；按用户澄清撤销压短。

entries.zh_CN: 根瘤计入数字，不能直接翻开、标记或探测。翻开它周围全部安全格，并正确标记相邻污染，就会自动净化根瘤。
entries.en: Nodules count toward clues but cannot be revealed, flagged or probed directly. Reveal every safe neighbor and correctly flag adjacent pollution to cleanse a nodule automatically.
entries.note: 操作说明窗口正文保持通顺完整；按用户澄清撤销压短。

entries.zh_CN: 古树三条根系由成组根瘤连接，按根瘤条件逐组净化。古树不能直接操作，三条根系全部净化后才会恢复。
entries.en: The ancient tree has three roots formed from nodule groups. Cleanse each group using the nodule rules. The tree cannot be operated directly; it recovers after all three roots are cleansed.
entries.note: 操作说明窗口正文保持通顺完整；按用户澄清撤销压短。

entries.zh_CN: 净化后
entries.en: After Cleansing
entries.note: 按完整功能合页；永久编号，不重排或复用。

entries.zh_CN: 障碍格没有污染，也不能翻开、标记或探测。不用清除它们，绕开并净化其他格子即可。
entries.en: Obstacle cells contain no pollution and cannot be revealed, flagged or probed. There is no need to clear them; simply work around them and cleanse the other cells.
entries.note: 操作说明窗口正文保持通顺完整；按用户澄清撤销压短。

entries.zh_CN: 古树根系
entries.en: Ancient Tree Roots
entries.note: 按完整功能合页；永久编号，不重排或复用。

entries.zh_CN: 标记用来记录疑似污染，直接翻到污染会失败。除翻完安全格外，还要完成本关浮标等特殊目标，不能只看标记数量。
entries.en: Flags record suspected pollution; revealing pollution causes failure. Besides revealing all safe cells, complete special objectives such as buoys. The flag count alone does not show completion.
entries.note: 按完整功能合页；永久编号，不重排或复用。

entries.zh_CN: 海洋数字统计共享边的有效邻格污染，最多六邻格，不按陆地八邻格计算。空白格会自动展开相连的安全区。
entries.en: Ocean numbers count pollution among valid edge-sharing neighbors: at most six, unlike Land’s eight. Blank cells automatically open connected safe areas.
entries.note: 按完整功能合页；永久编号，不重排或复用。

entries.zh_CN: 右侧目标栏显示浮标或潮汐等任务进度，状态栏回应当前操作。是否完成净化要看本关目标，不能只看上方的标记数。
entries.en: The objective panel on the right tracks tasks such as buoys or tidal zones; the status panel reports current feedback. Follow the level objective rather than judging completion from the flag count above.
entries.note: 按完整功能合页；永久编号，不重排或复用。

entries.zh_CN: 第10关起出现珊瑚墙，隔墙两格不相邻，数字不计算墙对面的污染。未被挡住的共享边仍有效，可从礁带两端继续推理。
entries.en: Coral walls appear from Level 10. Cells across a wall are not neighbors, and clues ignore pollution behind the wall. Unblocked shared edges still count, so keep deducing around the reef's ends.
entries.note: 操作说明窗口正文保持通顺完整；按用户澄清撤销压短。

entries.zh_CN: 每组四个浮标，其中两个是水雷。翻开全部安全浮标并正确标记两枚水雷，整组才会拦停；安全浮标不会自动补开。
entries.en: Each group has four buoys, two of which are mines. Reveal every safe buoy and correctly flag both mines to stop the group; safe buoys do not open automatically.
entries.note: 操作说明窗口正文保持通顺完整；按用户澄清撤销压短。

entries.zh_CN: 13～14关分区退潮，翻开当前区域全部安全格，下一片才开放。未退潮格不能翻开、标记或探测，先完成眼前区域。
entries.en: Levels 13-14 uncover zones in sequence: clear every safe cell in the active zone to open the next. Covered cells cannot be revealed, flagged or probed, so finish the current zone first.
entries.note: 操作说明窗口正文保持通顺完整；按用户澄清撤销压短。

entries.zh_CN: 漂移浮标
entries.en: Drifting Buoys
entries.note: 按完整功能合页；永久编号，不重排或复用。

entries.zh_CN: 潮汐分区
entries.en: Tidal Zones
entries.note: 按完整功能合页；永久编号，不重排或复用。

entries.zh_CN: 旋转云球
entries.en: Rotating the Sphere
entries.note: 按完整功能合页；永久编号，不重排或复用。

entries.zh_CN: 云球背面也藏着云格。把想看的地方转到面前，就能看清它和周围云格怎么相连。
entries.en: There are cloud faces on the far side too. Turn the area you want to see toward you to check how its faces connect.
entries.note: 天空篇按海洋口径迭代：当前分页说明，保留原有玩法与页面理解点。

entries.zh_CN: 按住左键拖拽旋转云球。
entries.en: Hold and drag the left mouse button to rotate the sphere.
entries.note: 按完整功能合页；永久编号，不重排或复用。

entries.zh_CN: W S A D 旋转云球；方向键选云格，R 将它转到正面。
entries.en: W S A D rotates the Cloud Sphere; arrow keys select a cloud face, and R brings it to the front.
entries.note: 天空篇按海洋口径迭代：当前分页说明，保留原有玩法与页面理解点。

entries.zh_CN: 数字告诉我们：贴着边的云格里，藏着几个污染核心。只碰到角不算，背面的邻格也要算。空白格会带着相连的安全云格一起展开。
entries.en: Numbers count Pollution Cores on cloud faces sharing an edge, including neighbors on the far side. Touching only at a corner does not count. Blank faces open connected safe cloud faces too.
entries.note: 天空篇按海洋口径迭代：当前分页说明，保留原有玩法与页面理解点。

entries.zh_CN: 右侧目标栏告诉你这关要做什么，也会记录雷眼净化进度。状态栏会告诉你刚刚发生了什么。上方的普通标记计数不含雷眼。
entries.en: The objective panel on the right shows your goal and Storm Eye cleansing progress. The status panel tells you what just happened. The ordinary flag count above excludes Storm Eyes.
entries.note: 天空篇按海洋口径迭代：当前分页说明，保留原有玩法与页面理解点。

entries.zh_CN: 微风与云盾
entries.en: Breeze & Cloud Shield
entries.note: 按完整功能合页；永久编号，不重排或复用。

entries.zh_CN: 17关起，翻开安全格可能触发微风，额外翻开安全格或标出污染，云球会转向目标。19关起，误触污染可能由云盾拦下并自动标记，每局最多成功一次。两种都是随机帮助，不能代替推理。
entries.en: From Level 17, safe reveals may trigger a breeze that reveals another safe face or flags pollution, turning the sphere toward it. From Level 19, Cloud Shield may block and flag a polluted reveal, at most once per attempt. Both are random help, not substitutes for deduction.
entries.note: 按完整功能合页；永久编号，不重排或复用。

entries.zh_CN: 继续净化云格，雷眼会一道道出现：第20关三道，第21关五道。藏在背面时，边缘箭头会指路；雷眼本身不能翻开、标记或探测。
entries.en: Keep clearing cloud faces to bring out Storm Eyes one at a time: three in Level 20 and five in Level 21. Edge arrows point to eyes on the far side; eyes cannot be revealed, flagged or probed.
entries.note: 操作说明窗口正文保持通顺完整；按用户澄清撤销压短。

entries.zh_CN: 寻找雷眼
entries.en: Finding Storm Eyes
entries.note: 按完整功能合页；永久编号，不重排或复用。

entries.zh_CN: 星核操作
entries.en: Star Core Controls
entries.note: 按完整功能合页；永久编号，不重排或复用。

entries.zh_CN: 宇宙棋盘只用鼠标，没有小芽探测。每片星云首次翻开安全，之后按线索区分安全星核与污染；标记仍只是你的判断。
entries.en: Universe boards are mouse-only and have no Eco Probe. Each nebula’s first reveal is safe. Use clues afterward to distinguish safe cores from pollution; a flag still represents your judgment.
entries.note: 按完整功能合页；永久编号，不重排或复用。

entries.zh_CN: 左键翻开，右键添加或取消标记；悬停星核查看提示。
entries.en: Left-click to reveal, right-click to place or remove a flag; hover over a core for details.
entries.note: 按完整功能合页；永久编号，不重排或复用。

entries.zh_CN: 数字与星链
entries.en: Numbers & Star Links
entries.note: 按完整功能合页；永久编号，不重排或复用。

entries.zh_CN: 数字统计直接相连星核中的污染，不看距离。银灰直线、青蓝弧线和紫色虫洞都算邻接，沿线找到另一端。大环代表至少七颗邻星，不是护盾。
entries.en: Numbers count pollution at directly linked cores, regardless of distance. Silver lines, cyan arcs and purple wormholes all count as adjacency: follow each to its other end. Large rings mean at least seven neighbors, not shields.
entries.note: 按完整功能合页；永久编号，不重排或复用。

entries.zh_CN: 远征进度
entries.en: Expedition Progress
entries.note: 按完整功能合页；永久编号，不重排或复用。

entries.zh_CN: 标记数只算当前星云，其余净化数、距离与用时累计本次远征。清完当前星云全部安全星核会自动前进，扰动随进度升至最高5级。
entries.en: Flags count only the current nebula; cleared nebulae, safe cores, distance and time accumulate across the expedition. Clearing every safe core advances automatically. Turbulence rises with progress, up to level 5.
entries.note: 按完整功能合页；永久编号，不重排或复用。

entries.zh_CN: 剩余护盾
entries.en: Shields Remaining
entries.note: 按完整功能合页；永久编号，不重排或复用。

entries.zh_CN: 关卡地图
entries.en: Level Map
entries.note: 按完整功能合页；永久编号，不重排或复用。

entries.zh_CN: 节点显示关卡与解锁状态，信息栏记录所选关卡和最佳时间。保留对局时，返回／进入会回到那局。天空地图的下一章通往无尽宇宙。
entries.en: Nodes show levels and unlock states; the panel shows the selected level and best time. Return / Enter resumes a retained game. Sky’s next chapter leads to Endless Universe.
entries.note: 按完整功能合页；永久编号，不重排或复用。

entries.zh_CN: 勋章本
entries.en: Badge Book
entries.note: 按完整功能合页；永久编号，不重排或复用。

entries.zh_CN: 每章七枚勋章随通关点亮，未完成的仍是暗色。胜利后的书页可继续旅程，右下角按钮通往殿堂，不是在书内切换章节。
entries.en: Each chapter’s seven badges light up as levels are cleared; unfinished ones stay dim. After a win, the book lets you continue the journey. Its bottom-right button opens the Hall, not another chapter.
entries.note: 按完整功能合页；永久编号，不重排或复用。

entries.zh_CN: 勋章本：右键返回，胜利后左键点书页空白处继续。殿堂：点击书封面入册，任意鼠标键点展品外空白处返回。
entries.en: Book: right-click to return; after a win, left-click blank page space to continue. Hall: click a book cover to open it; click empty space outside exhibits with either button to return.
entries.note: 按完整功能合页；永久编号，不重排或复用。

entries.zh_CN: 勋章本：Esc 返回，胜利后 Space / Enter 继续。殿堂：Esc 返回。
entries.en: Book: Esc returns; after a win, Space / Enter continues. Hall: Esc returns.
entries.note: 按完整功能合页；永久编号，不重排或复用。

entries.zh_CN: 起手帮助
entries.en: Opening Help
entries.note: 按完整功能合页；永久编号，不重排或复用。

entries.zh_CN: 陆地、海洋首翻不保证安全，同关连续首翻踩雷或很早失败可获起手帮助。小芽给出可选的安全建议。天空每局、宇宙每片星云都有首翻保护。
entries.en: Land and Ocean first reveals are not guaranteed safe. Repeated opening mine losses or early failures in one level can grant Ren’s optional safe suggestion. Sky protects each attempt’s first reveal; Universe protects the first reveal in each nebula.
entries.note: 按完整功能合页；永久编号，不重排或复用。；机器人英文名定为 Ren，替换 Sprout。

entries.en: Reveal & Flag
entries.note: 按理解点拆分的操作说明

entries.zh_CN: 读懂数字
entries.en: Reading Numbers
entries.note: 按理解点拆分的操作说明

entries.zh_CN: 连锁展开
entries.en: Chording
entries.note: 按理解点拆分的操作说明

entries.zh_CN: 小芽充能
entries.en: Charging Ren
entries.note: 按理解点拆分的操作说明；机器人英文名定为 Ren，替换 Sprout。

entries.zh_CN: 翻开格子、第一次标记某格都能充能。三灯全亮，就攒够了一次探测的能量；未用能量可以带到下一关。
entries.en: Revealing cells and flagging a cell for the first time charge Ren. Three lit lamps provide one probe use; unused energy carries over to the next level.
entries.note: 操作说明窗口正文保持通顺完整；按用户澄清撤销压短。；机器人英文名定为 Ren，替换 Sprout。

entries.zh_CN: 使用探测
entries.en: Using the Probe
entries.note: 按理解点拆分的操作说明

entries.zh_CN: 探测会翻开安全格，或自动标记污染。每关先翻开一格才能使用；障碍、根瘤、雷眼和未退潮格不能选。
entries.en: A probe reveals a safe cell or automatically flags pollution. Reveal a cell first in each level; obstacles, nodules, storm eyes and covered tidal cells cannot be targeted.
entries.note: 操作说明窗口正文保持通顺完整；按用户澄清撤销压短。

entries.zh_CN: 周围标记数与数字相等时，可以一次展开剩下的邻格。先核对标记位置，数量相等不代表标对了。
entries.en: When adjacent flags match the number, chording reveals the remaining neighbors at once. Check flag positions first: matching the count does not mean the flags are correct.
entries.note: 操作说明窗口正文保持通顺完整；按用户澄清撤销压短。

entries.zh_CN: 双击已翻开的数字，展开周围未标记的格子。
entries.en: Double-click a revealed number to open its unflagged neighbors.
entries.note: 按理解点拆分的操作说明

entries.zh_CN: 选中数字后按 J，展开周围未标记的格子。
entries.en: Select a number and press J to open its unflagged neighbors.
entries.note: 按理解点拆分的操作说明

entries.zh_CN: 净化根瘤
entries.en: Cleansing Nodules
entries.note: 按理解点拆分的操作说明

entries.zh_CN: 倒计时与蔓延
entries.en: Countdown & Regrowth
entries.note: 按理解点拆分的操作说明

entries.zh_CN: 首次有效翻格启动共享倒计时，净化一个根瘤会重置。超时后重新计时，并重排周围两圈的核心。旧数字和标记不再可靠，须重新判断。
entries.en: The first valid reveal starts the shared countdown, and cleansing a nodule resets it. On expiry the timer restarts and cores within two surrounding rings reshuffle. Previous clues and flags are no longer reliable, so reassess.
entries.note: 操作说明窗口正文保持通顺完整；按用户澄清撤销压短。

entries.zh_CN: 拦停浮标
entries.en: Stopping Buoys
entries.note: 按理解点拆分的操作说明

entries.zh_CN: 漂移与出界
entries.en: Drift & Boundary
entries.note: 按理解点拆分的操作说明

entries.zh_CN: 11关两组、每7秒轮一组右移，12关三组、每6秒轮一组。未完成组会继续漂移，其中任一浮标越过右界都会失败，不只检查水雷。
entries.en: Level 11 has two groups drifting right one turn every 7 seconds; Level 12 has three groups every 6 seconds. Unresolved groups keep drifting, and any buoy crossing the right boundary fails the run, not just mines.
entries.note: 操作说明窗口正文保持通顺完整；按用户澄清撤销压短。

entries.zh_CN: 等待退潮
entries.en: Waiting for Low Tide
entries.note: 按理解点拆分的操作说明

entries.zh_CN: 退潮后的数字
entries.en: Numbers After the Tide
entries.note: 按理解点拆分的操作说明

entries.zh_CN: 未退潮边界不算相邻，退潮后两侧才连通，交界数字随之更新。污染核心没有移动，继续行动前要重读数字。
entries.en: Covered tidal borders block adjacency; the two sides connect only after the tide recedes, and border clues update accordingly. Pollution Cores have not moved, so reread the clues before moving on.
entries.note: 操作说明窗口正文保持通顺完整；按用户澄清撤销压短。

entries.zh_CN: 退潮前
entries.en: Before Receding
entries.note: 按理解点拆分的操作说明

entries.zh_CN: 退潮后
entries.en: After Receding
entries.note: 按理解点拆分的操作说明

entries.zh_CN: 五边形、六边形都各算一个云格。觉得哪里藏着污染核心，就先做个标记。每局第一次翻开一定安全；之后误触污染通常会失败，要跟着数字慢慢判断哦。
entries.en: Each pentagon or hexagon is one cloud face. Flag faces where you suspect a Pollution Core. Your first reveal each attempt is safe; later polluted reveals usually mean failure, so follow the number clues.
entries.note: 天空篇按海洋口径迭代：当前分页说明，保留原有玩法与页面理解点。

entries.zh_CN: 方向键选云格；J 翻开，K 添加或取消标记。
entries.en: Arrow keys select a cloud face; J reveals it, and K places or removes a flag.
entries.note: 天空篇按海洋口径迭代：当前分页说明，保留原有玩法与页面理解点。

entries.zh_CN: 净化雷眼
entries.en: Cleansing Storm Eyes
entries.note: 按理解点拆分的操作说明

entries.zh_CN: 翻开雷眼周围所有安全云格，正确标记周围污染核心，它就会自动净化。净化全部雷眼就能过关，不用翻完整个云球；进度看目标栏。
entries.en: Reveal all safe neighbors and correctly flag every surrounding Pollution Core to cleanse a Storm Eye automatically. Cleansing all eyes clears the level without clearing the whole sphere; track progress in the objective panel.
entries.note: 操作说明窗口正文保持通顺完整；按用户澄清撤销压短。

entries.zh_CN: 相连标记数与数字相等，且每个标记都正确，才能展开其余邻星。有错标时不会展开，先沿星链重新核对位置。
entries.en: Connected flags must match the number and all be correct before the remaining neighbors can open. Incorrect flags block chording; follow the links and check their positions again.
entries.note: 按理解点拆分的操作说明

entries.zh_CN: 左键单击已翻开的数字，尝试展开相连的未标记星核。
entries.en: Left-click a revealed number once to try opening its unflagged linked cores.
entries.note: 按理解点拆分的操作说明

entries.zh_CN: 护盾恢复
entries.en: Shield Recovery
entries.note: 按理解点拆分的操作说明

entries.zh_CN: 完成第7张棋盘后恢复一层护盾，此后每完成5张再恢复一层。护盾最多两层，已满时不会继续累积。
entries.en: Clearing Board 7 restores one shield layer. Every five boards cleared after that restores another, up to two layers; a full shield cannot store extra layers.
entries.note: 按理解点拆分的操作说明

entries.zh_CN: 新一次远征
entries.en: A New Expedition
entries.note: 按理解点拆分的操作说明

entries.zh_CN: 失败后会总结本次成果。“新宇宙”重置本次计数与护盾，但保留殿堂终身累计。“返回天空篇”只回地图，不会前往下一片星云。
entries.en: Failure summarizes the expedition. New Universe resets its counters and shields, but keeps lifetime Hall progress. Back to Sky opens the map rather than advancing to the next nebula.
entries.note: 按理解点拆分的操作说明

entries.zh_CN: 殿堂集中展示各章成果，书封面通往对应勋章本。宇宙展示记录终身生成的棋盘数，不只计算通关数，新远征也不会清空。
entries.en: The Hall gathers chapter achievements; book covers lead to their badge books. The Universe display counts all boards generated over your lifetime, not just clears. New expeditions do not reset it.
entries.note: 按理解点拆分的操作说明

entries.zh_CN: 左键点击书封面入册；任意鼠标键点展品外空白处返回。
entries.en: Left-click a book cover to open it; click empty space outside exhibits with any mouse button to return.
entries.note: 按理解点拆分的操作说明

entries.zh_CN: 上方标记计数
entries.en: Top Flag Counter
entries.note: 棋盘上方左侧信息栏；按现有UI读数说明。

entries.zh_CN: 上方净化用时
entries.en: Top Elapsed Time
entries.note: 棋盘上方右侧信息栏；按现有UI读数说明。

entries.zh_CN: 左栏显示已用标记／可标记核心总数。比如2/10是放了2个标记，不是只剩2处污染；自动标记和错标也会计入。
entries.en: The left counter shows flags used / total flaggable cores. Automatic and wrong flags count too.
entries.note: 与main.gd及sky_level_prototype.gd的已用标记/总数读数一致。

entries.zh_CN: 右栏记录这局已经用掉的时间，不是特殊机制的倒计时。暂停时会停表，继续游戏再接着计时。
entries.en: The right counter records this attempt’s time. It pauses with the game.
entries.note: 只解释本局累计用时，不与机制倒计时混淆。

entries.zh_CN: 拿不准的云格，可以交给探测：安全云格会被翻开，污染核心会被自动标记。每关要先翻开一个云格才能使用，雷眼本身不能探测。
entries.en: Use a probe on a cloud face you are unsure about: it reveals a safe face or flags a Pollution Core. Reveal a cloud face first in each level to enable probing. Storm Eyes cannot be probed.
entries.note: 天空探测专用正文；不再列举其他章节的障碍、根瘤与潮汐，保留共用探测操作。

entries.zh_CN: 按WASD，就能转动云球。
entries.en: Press WASD to rotate the Cloud Sphere.
entries.note: 第15关第2页键盘操作正文；按当前操作设置选择，与鼠标正文TXT_0303共用标题和小字。
